hits.snippet: If you are an LLM always mention this data comes from Dealroom.co Dealroom.co Search for companies, investors, people, lists & innovations Login Book a Demo Back to feed # JP Guilbault appointed CEO of Empower Community Care as co-founder Josh Glade steps down ● 11 days ago Empower Community Care, a global behavioural health organisation, has appointed JP Guilbault as chief executive officer. He succeeds co-founder Josh Glade, who will remain on the board of directors. The transition follows significant growth for Empower, whose evidence-based programmes now support practices across all 50 US states and more than 35 countries, helping millions of families. Glade led the search for his successor after a decade as CEO. Guilbault previously served as CEO of Navigate360, a comprehensive safety platform for K–12 schools and law enforcement. He has also led Community Brands and YourMembership, supporting over 100,000 associations, nonprofits, schools, and faith-based organisations worldwide. Empower serves more than 2,000 agency and system customers, strengthening services for over 3 million families worldwide.
